body.title: Make every automated content writer address nothing
body.summary: Pass addresses [] from the three automated content callers: the controller's review auto-fix in src/daemon/steps/review-step/phases/verdicts.ts, the daemon review auto-fix in src/workflow/review/run-artifact.ts, and storeRound in src/workflow/runners/build/round-writer.ts (BUILD, TESTS and code-review rounds, also reached from ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion). Record the inventory of updateContent, update and write callers in the plans document with the decision for each.
acceptanceChecks: a review auto-fix on the controller path and on the daemon path leaves an open revision request open
a BUILD, TESTS or code-review round record leaves open feedback on that record open
every production caller of updateContent, update and write is listed in the plans document with its decision
the review-step, run-artifact and round-recording tests pass

tests.name: automated-writers-addresses.test.ts: a review auto-fix on either path and a BUILD, TESTS or code-review round leave open feedback open
